gen-gf-chilanka-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads curvy and loose, its tall lowercase and stubby ascender tips drawn with a wire-thin line. Chilanka's hand-drawn warmth sits lower in height, and that gap is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-erode: Dignified and a touch editorial, Erode carries a tall middle band and a stroke that swells and thins just enough to feel alive. Chilanka's heading stays uniform and hand-drawn; nudge the serif body up a size if it feels tight.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads clean and generous, with a tall x-height and wide-mouthed s curves. Make Chilanka small and its relaxed handwriting fades fast, while a large body would crowd the heading's softer hand.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-public-sans: Chilanka writes its heading in one unvaried stroke with a graceful hand-drawn feel, while Public Sans lays down a hefty, open lowercase. One is best at charm, the other at steady footing.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and dense, a heavy band of text with letters held open rather than curled shut. And Chilanka is best at relaxed handwriting with almost no stroke contrast, where the body simply holds the line.
gen-gf-chilanka-general-sans: Chilanka's heading shows a hand-drawn line with graceful, wide apertures and no change in pressure. But General Sans keeps a tall x-height and smooth curves, so a longer stretch moves along without snagging.
gen-gf-chilanka-gf-hepta-slab: Bookish and dignified, Hepta Slab stretches each word out, with open counters and a bent-paperclip line. Hepta Slab against Chilanka's loose handwriting makes the strongest quality here the contrast of hand and slab.
gen-gf-chilanka-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru spaces its letters generously, with terminals stopping far from the stem and rings of o that hold a constant wall. And Chilanka's hand-drawn, graceful heading gives that traditional tone a relaxed, personal counterpoint.
gen-gf-chilanka-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Chilanka's most distinctive trait is its uniform, hand-drawn stroke, with counters that stay open to the outside. Padyakke Expanded One answers with wide, spread-out glyphs, and the literary weight between them is the pair's real draw.
gen-gf-chilanka-gf-science-gothic: Chilanka's handwritten heading keeps one stroke thickness throughout, relaxed and graceful, with counters open to the outside. Science Gothic follows in a sans with stroke ends far apart, so each line feels approachable.
